title: AFP prioritizes missile capabilities for territorial defense

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) is prioritizing missile systems and other weapons capabilities to strengthen its territorial defense and deter potential threats amid the presence of Chinese naval vessels along international sea routes near the country.
